document: Close the border, to infected nations, to prevent the spread of COVID-19, The Home Office must declare COVID-19 as a national threat and therefore, close the borders to infected nations. If we continue to allow people through the border, the coronavirus will only spread more rapidly, and further afield., Closing the borders to infected nations is in the upmost interest of our nation. Common sense dictates that when you let people enter the country from areas with deadly diseases, viruses or infections, the nations risk of developing those diseases, viruses or infections increases detrimentally. The government must take proper measures to ensure the safety of its citizens, if that means closing the border, then so be it.

Ban all single use plastic, I want there to be a ban on all single use plastic e.g. plastic packaging for fruit and veg, plastic bottles, plastic on cans of alcohol, plastic bags in supermarkets because half of these things end up in land fill sights, oceans and on land in places where animals inhabit., I’m very passionate about the environment and I want serious change to be made to the way in which things are packaged as their are many animals that are being killed and fooled by plastic in oceans and on land. Plastic is ridiculously bad for the environment and needs to be banned urgently. We need change in this country in the way in which things are packaged and there are so many alternatives to single use plastic.

Ban pelagic trawlers, attach pingers to all boats, stop slaughter of dolphins., Last year the Margiris Super Trawler was off the coast of Sussex, this trawler has been banned around the world, due to the damage to marine mammals. Since then several large pelagic factory ships have been operating around the coast. consequently 100s of dead dolphins have washed up on beaches., The UK Government should work internationally to ban these trawlers and remove them from UK waters. All fishing vessels that fish our seas to have pingers attached, that deter dolphins from being in the area of the net. Reducing the number of large trawlers, would make the sea more sustainable, plus allowing more fish to be caught by the local fisherman, retaining more jobs and prosperity in seaside towns. The increase in dolphin numbers would also encourage tourists to visit these towns, giving coastal resorts an investment at no cost.

Ban spitting in the street especially in light of the covid-19 threat, Spitting in the streets is a major problem in the UK and it needs to be banned as it is in places like Singapore and Hong Kong, Spitting is unsightly, makes our streets dirty but more importantly contributes to the spread of airborne diseases and those that spread through body fluids

Help independent businesses creating regeneration in struggling High Streets., As a new business opening on the high street I would like to see more support given to independent small family businesses like our. Businesses that will create foot fall into the high street. As a business with a community ethos, an aim to be carbon neutral and also reduce food and packaging waste., I would like to see a review of business rates, including a rate free period that allows new tenants to fit out their shop without being stung with full commercial rates as their building is classed as unoccupied. 

We were charged £798 for 1 month due to this legislation. We had applied for the help with reducing our commercial rates, this was in place and meant it would be £143 per month. This additional charge we were not told about means we now have no cooker!? We are a food business!

Run a nationwide information campaign to reduce roadside litter., The Government needs to urgently address roadside litter by running a sustained and high profile information campaign to remind drivers not to throw litter from vehicles. All media channels need to be used.  The campaign also needs to include frequent road signs to reinforce the message., Lifestyles have changed hugely in the last 5 years with a big increase in eating on the go, especially in vehicles (the UK uses over 2bn disposable coffee cups a year). The growth in e-commerce has created many jobs that require people to work out of cars and vans. Bin infrastructure has not changed and waste collection budgets reduced.  As a result roadsides are used as a dumping ground for all forms of litter and waste.

Hold a referendum to scrap the UK's policy of Net Zero CO2 by 2050, We need a referendum - The Net Zero CO2 policy was waved through parliament without any meaningful debate, proper costings or cost benefit analysis. There was no party in the 2019 general election standing in all 650 seats that was against net zero to give voters the choice to vote against it., The financial and freedom implications of Net Zero have not been explained, along with the fact that the UK produces less than 1% of global man-made CO2 emissions. Even reducing this to zero will have no impact on global man-made CO2 emissions, weather or climate as the big emitters like China (30%) and India have energy policies that will continue to increase global CO2 emissions to 2035 and beyond. A unilateral or limited net zero could just move UK emissions and jobs overseas.

Stop Minting 1p & 2p Coins , Stop Minting 1p & 2p Coins (It's a waste of money!), Minting 1p & 2p coins is a waste of money, they cost more to make than the metal they are made of. 

Nothing costs this little anymore and some people throw these coins away. They are useless and pointless.

Create charge for use of non-biodegradable material, Single use plastic, particularly in the food industry, is having a detrimental impact on the environment. Parliament should make a law that requires businesses to charge for these products if customers require single use plastic products (such as plastic straws) made from non-biodegradable material., In 2015 it was made law in the UK that large retailers could charge 5p for the requirement of plastic bags. Climate change and the impact of single use plastics is a topic which is always on the public agenda for discussion in the UK. We would like to see a progressive approach to the law in this area and therefore we would like to gain support for a charge for all single use plastics.

Remove the protected status of badgers., Badgers are an unendangered apex predator that kill the likes of hedgehogs that are now an endangered species. As they hold protected status yet are unendangered themselves the population is getting out of control. , Also continuing to then transmit TB, directly impacting thousands of cattle both commercial and rare breeds.

APHA say around 30,000 cattle are killed every year due to TB. Much of the slaughtered meat goes into food chain as there are no confirmed cases of humans contracting TB from infected meat. So why are the TB tests happening? Killing cattle is not solving the issue as it's not tackling the source of the problem. It is further damaging an industry that is already on its knees.

Include gardening in the National Curriculum, As part of their science classes, children could have an applied session to plant and harvest vegetables. In the process, they could learn the benefits of growing one's greens, composting & recycling & the benefits for the environment., Education is the basis of a good, responsible citizen. In light of the current climate, it is important that future generations understand the basis of a sustainable economy, food sourcing and waste management.

Ban wearing face coverings in public places., Very recently the Sri Lankan and Tunisian governments have banned full face coverings and coverings where only the eyes can be seen in public places for security reasons. We should too.,

Make university fees free, The fee punishes people for going to university., We want university fees to be taken away so that it is free for people to attend a university. We believe that the fee for universities is far too high and can deter people from going to university. If the price is taken away more people will be able to attend which means the country will have more highly qualified professionals.

Remove VAT on Energy Efficiency Measures To Help Meet 2050 Emissions Target, Taxing people who voluntarily choose to upgrade the energy efficiency of their home goes against the government’s 2050 zero carbon target. Particularly as people building new homes that will ultimately add carbon emissions pay no VAT at all., Government signed the 2050 Net Zero emissions commitment into law in 2019 and that legislation has since been cited in the decision to prevent a third runway at Heathrow. While VAT on measures such as insulation and heat pumps has been reduced to 5%, it remains at 20% for items like LED lighting and Heat Recovery Ventilation, both of which are essential for a low carbon home. Zero-rating energy saving technologies would stimulate growth in the low carbon economy at a critical time for the UK.

Require recycling systems in NHS clinical areas for plastic healthcare waste, Across the NHS, there are no means of sustainably disposing of uncontaminated plastic clinical waste (namely sterile packaging). This means that huge quantities of potentially recyclable plastic are disposed of daily and sent to landfills or incinerators, greatly harming our environment., There are no formal recycling plans or mechanisms in place across NHS clinical environments, which we believe is wholly unsustainable. We want to have this changed and for recycling to be the new norm when it comes to uncontaminated clinical and non-clinical waste in the healthcare industry. See www.recycle-health.org”

Start online classes in UK because of the COVID-19, Start online classes , so that students could have classes online and stay safe from the COVID-19, Because lots of students on Coventry university I know are worried and scared to go to class because of the virus it will be great if online classes started

Stop flight from/to Italy, Coronavirus ( COVID-19) cases are rising every day in Italy and we have already gotten few coronavirus cases in UK of people who have been to Italy and come back and resulted positive to the coronavirus., To try to help our country to get less contages of coronavirus we are asking the government to stop flight/to from Italy has they have the majority of cases of coronavirus (COVID-19).

Ban the sale of artificial grass, The sale of artificial grass should be banned in the UK for environmental reasons. It is environmentally irresponsible to allow garden space occupied by grass and other plant life (which processes CO2 and supports wildlife) to be replaced by plastic which does not biodegrade., It is widely accepted that planting trees and other plants is beneficial in the fight against climate change due to their ability to process CO2. Grass and other plant life also support our wildlife. Artificial grass offers no benefit to wildlife.

Artificial grass is made from plastic and will not biodegrade. Its manufacture also has a carbon footprint.

For those who do not want the maintenance of plants, decking or patios are an alternative which do not contribute towards the plastic problem.

Allow symptomatic health professionals the coronavirus test, Allow symptomatic health professionals to have the coronavirus test even if no direct contact. Presently they can only have the test if they returned from a high risk area or had direct contact with a case., 10% of Italian doctors are infected. Testing health professionals who are sick with high fever etc is necessary to protect their patients, colleagues and families and in order to maintain NHS business continuity. These doctors may have been on the tube, at mass gatherings etc. This is a ticking time bomb but the government has a chance to mitigate damage by acting NOW!!!

pass the legislation to prevent schools or local authorities from taking action, We would like to call on the Government to pass legislation to prevent schools or local authorities from taking action against parents who have kept their children at home because of the COVID-19 outbreak. 
There are many parents already removing there children most are de registering., Because Professionals do not know enough about the decease to 100% ensure our children and or their family’s are safe if a child picked it up at school and is a symptomatic will pass it to family that could be old and or vulnerable. As well as many children being vulnerable and having health issues. We understand the economy of closing all schools but for those parents that are able to do this should be given the option. It’s a safe guarding concern by any parent and should be taken seriously.

Implement UK lockdown for preventing spread of COVID19, The UK needs to follow suit the containment procedures of countries that have been greatly affected by COVID19 such as Italy.

The UK should restrict unnecessary travel between towns and cities. Travel permitted should only be for work or emergencies. Public gatherings should also be discouraged., It is time the government should prioritise the health of the public and should consider how vital it is to implement effective containment now.

It is better to spend money to contain the virus and treating the relatively low numbers who are ill now rather than wait for more casualties.

Government starts encouraging public wearing masks, Government starts encouraging public wearing masks and also manufacturers to set up masks production line.Moreover, government spares no effort to procure the masks all over the world, As I have read the data graph about coronavirus of Professor Mark Handley from UCL. The trend of coronavirus in UK is very similar to Italy. And the graph shows that the trend line of Japan is different to other European countries, I believe it is because the public in Japan has high awareness of wearing masks to prevent the spread of virus. 
I think it is urgent for the government to take actions, otherwise, UK has to lockdown the country like Italy

close all business in the UK for the coronavirus pandemic, close all business , school , in the UK for the coronavirus epidemic .
leave only primary goods stores open.,

Close all educational facilities due to spreading of coronavirus (COVID-19), Close all educational facilities to help stop the spread of coronavirus (COVID-19) children and young people may not be the high risk age but they high risk spreaders, Take Italy as a reference to how bad it could be within a week

Provide supplies and medical teams to support Italy., China is now sending doctors, masks and hazmat suits to help italy with its coronavirus outbreak. Britain should also provide supplies and medical teams to support Italy. No one can survive the pandemic without helping each other., The situation in Italy today is very similar to that in Hubei Province, China one month ago. The outbreak in Hubei Province, China, was brought under control due to substantial support from other parts of China. Britain has good medical resources and should help Italy control the epidemic.

Do NOT close schools/university over Coronavirus unless absolutely necessary., To consider the intense impact of stopping education for young people unnecessarily and to reconsider not closing anything unless absolutely necessary., The media have blown Coronavirus completely out of proportion and the population have lapped it up as they thrive on something to worry and gossip about. 

These kind of precautions were never put in place for other illnesses which were much more lethal.

By turning the world up side down is completely unnecessary and it is getting out of control. The best thing we can do is maintain normality.

Test anyone showing Covid19 symptoms including mild & increase contact tracing, Increase covid19 testing: All patients showing showing covid19 symptoms, no matter how mild should be able to be tested, even if that means them having to pay towards private testing. Contact tracing should be increased to isolate possible new cases., It has been shown in Korea and the other previously affected countries that increased testing, screening and contact tracing greatly reduces the spread of the virus.

Show detailed assumptions and calculations of the government’s coronavirus model, The UK government repeatedly claim that their coronavirus strategy is based on the science. They must make the detailed scientific references, assumptions and calculations a open source to the public. Therefore all the scientists could endorse or challenged their model and their decisions., There is only one life per person. Every death devastates a family.
Based on the government’s statement, they need 60% of British population to be infected, which means almost 40 million people. With 1% of fatality, this means 400,000 British death! In addition, 20% of the cases need hospilisation, which means 8,000,000 hospital beds need to be available with the NHS!
The government must provide transparency on this serious issue as early as possible! The British people need to be protected!

The Government must reinstate testing for Coronavirus COVID-19., In order to collect more reliable data on the spread of the Coronavirus COVID-19, the government needs to reinstate general testing of the public with mild symptoms, and to continue contact-tracing. This action needs to be taken fast., The Government and health services need good data to inform the science they are using to combat the spread of the Coronavirus COVID-19. Reinstating testing will give a better idea of the progress of the infection among the population. Without this we will face increasing uncertainty about the success of the measures decided upon. People who are falling ill need to know if they have contracted the virus as this will affect their behaviour, and will help to protect others.

Decline any requests for bailouts from the airline industry, Cease any investment and subsidies in the aviation industry and support the employees to transition into roles in 'greener' transport., To protect citizens from the worst impacts of climate change and biodiversity loss by stopping investment in industry that does not support the commitment to (net) zero emissions by 2050, which is arguably an insufficient ambition.

Purchase more heart-lung machines to fight Covid-19 coronavirus, Ministers need to drastically ramp up the purchase of ventilators and Heart-Lung machines and ECMO beds. The machines are an essential part of treating those with severe cases of COVID-19, when a sticky mucus fills patients' lungs preventing them from breathing., We want the Government to: 
1) Publish how many ventilators, heart-lung machines & ECMO beds they will purchase!
2) Publish when they will purchase them.
3) Publish the date those machines will enter service.
4) Actually follow through and buy the machines.
Basically: we want them to accept the BMA's position that we don't have enough and put the required funding behind an order for those machines to rectify the short-fall as soon as possible.

Ban using fish as prizes at carnivals or other similar events., Ban the sale of animals such as fish at carnivals across the country., Many of these fish are killed by people who attend fairs and the conditions that they suffer before they are sold like living in a plastic bag hung on a wall is despicable.

Allow all plastics to be recycled. Pass the sorting responsibilities to councils, Councils such as Greater Manchester are running a #GotToBeABottle campaign for what can be recycled. All plastics should be acceptable as the Local Authority should be responsible for sorting/recycling dependent on plastic type such as PETE/HDPE/PVC/LDPE/PP/PS/OTHER., There are so many different plastics about that it’s hard to tell what each one is. It’s ok to say #GotToBeABottle but if all plastics were recycled, the volume of plastic being discarded of would decrease and the plastic can then be sorted into types. For example, the Happy Meal toys from McDonald’s cannot be recycled and they sell approx 3.5million Happy Meals per day. That’s a lot of waste plastic alone.

The Government must immediately start planning and building temporary hospitals., The Government must urgently consider using whatever powers it has at its disposal, to explore the swift and safe building of temporary hospitals, for the NHS to provide enough beds to cover the extra demand there will be during the peak crisis of the Covid-19 outbreak., Data from NHS England shows we are already frequently operating at around 80% capacity of our entire Critical Care bed capacity: https://www.england.nhs.uk/…/critical-care-bed-capacity-an…/.

The lives of hundreds of thousands of our nearest and dearest relatives are in the hands of this Government, and they must do more to protect them.

Funding to fast track recruitment of newly qualified Physician Associates, On 12th March a new cohort of Physician Associates became qualified.  Many of these have yet to secure NHS employment due to trusts simply not having the funding available at present.  Please commit to emergency funding to fast track the recruitment of these useful healthcare professionals., Given the current circumstances every trained healthcare professional is vital.

Test Test Test - Corona virus testing for all, Increase testing across communities - you can’t fight a war blindfolded. Stop hiding the real figures and get all those infected tracked and informed., It’s utterly shambolic that we are not mass testing at a rapid rate.

Include High Street Estate Agents in Business rate suspension, Confirm that the recently announce business rate holiday in other sectors will Include Estate Agents based in High Street premises paying under £51,000, At this time small local businesses in the Estate and Lettings agency business need the same support from government given to other sectors. These local entrepreneurs employ local people to support the community and the Covid 19 outbreak is having the same financial impact on the property sector. Not to include Estates agents, based in the same locations is prejudice and putting jobs at risk.

Government should requisition private hospitals during the coronavirus crisis., We will require a huge amount of resources when the coronavirus outbreak reaches its peak. It is unlikely that current bed numbers or resources will be sufficient. These resources should be requisitioned from private health care sources to provide equal access to medical treatment for all., The government should not use public money to do this except to pay potential additional staffing costs or material costs.

Allow Coach Drivers to take a Fast track HGV license to keep the country going., With events/venues being shut and possible school closures there are plenty of coach companies that will be facing difficult times and possibly drivers being laid off. Therefore I recommend coach drivers be giving HGV licenses with either a fast track license or training to help with supplies., Coach companies are already started to suffer with drivers facing job losses not to mention the demand on supplies will be greater if the country goes into lockdown, and with coach drivers that drive equivalent if not bigger vehicles already it will help take any strain off the transport division.

Offer wide scale community testing for coronavirus, I call on the government to offer wide scale community/population testing for anyone who suspects they have the virus and contact tracing to identify and seclude clusters of infections? Ideally through mobile testing centres/drive thorough testing available in every town., We cannot stop this pandemic, if we don’t know who is infected. Testing only those in hospitals gives us no clear sense of how or where this virus is spreading.

The most effective way to prevent infections and save lives is “breaking the chains of transmission”.

Ask the British people to give their unused face masks to the NHS - #protectus, There is a national NHS shortage of FFP-3 masks. Provide a system for rapid retrieval of unused masks to the NHS to save the lives of frontline health care workers - without whom the provision of life saving care during the epidemic will fail., Critical care health care workers will soon face an impossible choice. Shortage of FFP-3 masks will soon require health care workers to provide life saving treatment to Covid-19 patients without adequate protection risking their lives in the process. 

Initiating life support is a high exposure process and requires an FFP-3 mask for all health care workers involved. Many of the the public will have purchased these masks. They do not require them if they stay at home and follow guidance.

Full PPE Protection for Frontline NHS staff throughout COVID-19 Pandemic, Provide full PPE protection with fitted respirator masks, eye protection, gowns and gloves for staff working in high risk zones., Current provisions for NHS staff are not adequate and staff are falling ill with coronavirus. Most staff working in high risk areas are in simple surgical masks, plastic aprons and gloves that do not provide enough exposure protection. We have staff falling ill and some requiring admission for breathing support. We need protection for frontline staff to stop the health service collapsing. 

https://www.theguardian.com/society/2020/mar/16/not-fit-for-purpose-uk-medics-condemn-covid-19-protection

Provide a full body suit to the NHS to use as a personal protective equipment, The PPE used at present in the NHS expose: head, knees and shoes. Providing a full body suit will prevent the spread of the virus and will protect the NHS staff from getting sick.The staff is risking to get infected and therefore to infect their families every day., The Government needs to protect the NHS staff and to insure a safe work environment. Safety is a right that all the NHS members need to be insured, especially during the covid-19 emergency. The NHS staff is managing the covid-19 infected patients with ineffective and unsafe protective personal equipment (PPE). The latter are exposing the head, the knees and the shoes. In contrast, China and Italy have provided a full body suit as a PPE to safeguard the health of the staff. Please act soon.

Test everyone  for Corona virus as recommended by the World Health Organisation, Follow the guidelines recommend by the World Health Organisation ,  provide the tests to everyone,, It all come down to information being so very important , the world needs to know exactly how many cases and where they are to be able to track and isolate this virus and save lives...

https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-8117701/amp/World-Health-Organization-attacks-UK-not-testing-coronavirus-patients.html#aoh=15845233823159&referrer=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com&amp_tf=From%20%251%24s

Close all non essential shops during the Covid-19 crisis, To close all non essential shops and (fashion,homeward, jewellery etc) shopping centres during the Covid-19 crisis ensuring workers receive pay. As busy shops are putting both retail workers and customers at risk to infection. Due to the layout of shops it is hard to maintain social distancing., To close all non essential shops ensuring the retail workers continue to be paid. Thus protecting them from infection. Also with the closing of schools and self isolation of over 70's child care will be incredibly difficult to find.

Get all careworkers paid more than minimum wage., I want careworkers to get more than minimum wage working with vulnerable adults, they have proven they are the backbone of the UK during this Covid-19 pandemic, I think our vulnerable adults would be at risk if they didn’t have carers risking their lives in this pandemic to support them, they do an excellent job and they deserve a good wage not just now but always

Ensure NHS well equipped with medical protective equipment for coronavirus., We want the government to ensure health workers dealing with all patients with symptoms of coronavirus, regardless of what they are treated for, to have PPE level cover, and those who treat coronavirus patients with more protective level medical suit, glasses and facial mask., We have seen in China, Italy and other countries where doctors and health workers having high risk of contracting the virus and then spreading it to patients. We want the government to take all measures including considering to open a channel for public donation for certified medical protective equipment, to help our NHS to prepare for the pandemic.

Close all retail stores to protect all retail workers from the COVID-19, The government should order all retail stores to close. There are many retail stores still open which are making workers more vulnerable and at high risk of getting infected which will result into a rise in the number of cases and deaths., The government or parliament needs to do this in order to protect all UK citizens and residents from COVID-19. People are being told to socially distance however, this is not possible for retail workers dealing with customers for 8 hours a day.

reach out to other countries for Protective equipments for NHS frontline staff, There are countries like China that has got goggles, face masks etc to be able to purchase with a very reasonable price, why not get for the NHS frontline staff?,

Protect essential workers from contracting and spreading Covid-19., The implementation of government guidelines for essential workers based on medical and scientific advice is now fundamental to protect their health, and the health of members of the public that they come into contact with both at work and at home., We ask for detailed and mandatory safety guidelines for essential workers, specific to each type of job, which have to be followed by those workers and members of the public that they come into contact with (e.g. limiting the number of customers entering shops, maintaining 1 metre distance when queuing). Essential workers should be provided with personal protective equipment (e.g. masks, gloves) to limit the transmission of Covid-19 and should be prioritised for testing when symptoms develop.

Rent Relief for Places Of Worship & Community Institutions, Due to the threat of Coronavirus, faith communities gathering together for prayer and worship have been instructed by the government to cease in order to minimise the spread of this virus. 

However they're still required to pay their rent & service charges and this will be impossible., Places of Worship Premises, whether private or council are still expected to pay their rent.

The majority of  Places Of Worship and other community institutions rely on voluntary contributions from the regular congregation and service users in order to exist and deliver services, and this is not possible with the current circumstances of COVID-19.

We would like to request for a government rent-waiver, until it's safe to re-open.

Temporarily close non-essential retail stores and ensure pay for employees, I am asking the Government to enforce a temporary ban on trading for non-essential retailers, such as clothing shops, during the Coronavirus epidemic. This is to ensure workers are protected from becoming ill or infecting others. These workers should be paid for their time off and keep their jobs., Retail workers potentially come into contact with hundreds of customers each day. Therefore, the risk of these employees contracting, carrying or spreading Coronavirus is high. Keeping non-essential stores open is not only dangerous to them but to their families. 

Those still going into work are scared to do so in a time where collective mental health is already at a low. Do the right thing and close non-essential retail stores until the epidemic passes and ensure employees continue to be paid.

Make wearing a face mask in public compulsory to stop spreading covid-19, In help to tackle coronavirus and to stop the spreading, wearing a face mask in all public areas should be made compulsory for everyone. It is vital that everyone understands how this virus works and how dangerous it can be. Protect ourselves, protect others!, Coronavirus affects respiratory system and it can be vital for elderly, vulnerable people with either underlying health conditions, people with asthma and others high risk groups. As a nation we need to take a responsibility and protect others from us and protect ourselves from others. When people go shopping and don't wear a face mask, it is more likely the spread will continue. Many other countries legalised wearing a face mask in all public places. We need this spread to stop quickly!

Supply surgical masks to be used by the general public, Surgical masks are known to reduce the likelihood of transmission in some circumstances. The Government should supply and mandate the use of surgical masks for the general public for day to day use, in the street and on public transport., People with COVID-19 are infectious before they are symptomatic which can result in people spreading the virus without being aware they have it. This is partially responsible for its rapid spread.
 
If we can mitigate a major infection vector by wearing surgical masks where possible we can further flatten the curve!

Allow gyms and leisure centres to reopen, The goal is to get the government to rethink their decision to close gyms and leisure centres and to come to an agreement to reopen them. As myself and many people rely on gym as part of therapy or a source of happiness I think it would be beneficial for all to reopen them., We want the government to change its decision and allow gyms and leisure centres across the UK to reopen. This is because people rely on these facilities to reach their goals of fitness. Shutting gyms limits opportunities to exercise which could affect people’s mental and physical wellbeing.

All Holiday resorts England to close to prevent the spread of Covid-19., All holiday Resorts should close to stop the spread of the Coronavirus/Covid-19.

People on holiday are not self isolating and are risking the vulnerable., As already explained

Allow fishing on rivers during the close season from now until the 15/06/2020., This should be an immediate relaxation of the coarse fishing close season on all uk rivers., To enable fishing on all rivers to help with social distancing and encourage people to get outside in relative isolation during these exceptional times.

Make any bailouts for UK airlines conditional on reducing emissions, The government needs to make UK airlines reduce carbon emissions as a condition of receiving a bail out to survive the COVID-19 outbreak. Currently the government don’t include international flights in the UK carbon budget, and not enough is being done to reduce emissions from this sector., The current circumstances present an opportunity to request airlines to reduce their emission intensity, to help the UK conform to the UN Paris Agreement. This needs to include actual commitments to reducing emissions rather than just offsetting. Worse crises than the one we’re living through could happen if we don’t take action to create a sustainable future.

Provide PPE including face masks for key workers during the Covid19 crisis., During the current covid-19 crisis across the UK there are certain key workers who are in higher risk enviroments. Settings such as nurseries where staff members are forced to be in close contact with children are particularly vunerable to infection and should therefore be provided with proper PPE., The health and safety of workers in these key areas is essential to carry out the plan which the government is setting forth to combat this disease. Providing effective PPE for those most at risk will help ensure that key workers remain healthy for work and be able to carry out their essential roles amid this crisis. PPE will help key workers feel safe and protected and encourage those who are fearful for the health of themselves and close ones to continue to work and be productive.

Stop all unnecessary travel especially to UK seaside/holiday resorts, With the Covid-19 accelerating across the country and in light of social distancing in place, I would like to raise the concern that there is an increased presence in holiday resorts throughout the UK., Members of the public have been contacting the Holiday Parks & Campsites only to be informed that as long as there is NOT an announcement restricting this, they will continue to take people in.

This could have devastating effects on areas that are already struggling: 

1). Adding to the regions NHS resources
2). Increase in demand from the already overstretched food suppliers
3). Increased risk of spreading the disease

Please ENFORCE the request for non-essential travel as soon as possible

Provide WHO standard PPE immediately to ALL frontline NHS staff AND care workers, Immediately distribute WHO standard PPE to all frontline NHS staff and care home workers. Accept that this simple measure would greatly improve patient contacts and stop infecting frontline staff unnecessarily, potentially spreading COVID-19 further to at risk groups.
Force manufacturers: make more, This is a simple, achievable set of products to manufacture rapidly and immediately protects the lives of frontline staff. It will prevent the spread of the disease in an already over-stretched NHS.

All frontline staff are at risk due to the current government provision of inadequate PPE.  Lives will be lost and the spread cannot be contained with such a glaring oversight by government.

This basic infection control measure in hospitals, primary care and care homes will save lives.

SAVE our STAFF - FFP3 face masks for all ICU staff caring for Covid-19 patients., NHS guidelines for staff caring for patients with an infectious respiratory virus require staff to wear FFP3 masks and not surgical masks. They are being broken as staff only have an FFP3 for intubation. Surgical masks are useless as a protection in ICU. Without FFP3 masks - staff will die., Supply all ICU units with sufficient FFP3 masks. Purchase directly from relevant manufacturers such as Silverline.com.
Compulsorily purchase all FFP3 masks from Screwfix, Serco, B&Q, and other similar stores. 
Distribute all FFP3 masks to ICU staff.

The new year is a time that people decide to start a more healthy lifestyle.  As a country, we must use the last nine months as a platform to encourage people to take responsibility for their health.

Closure of exercise facilities will undoubtedly increase depression, illness, obesity and suicides within the UK even further.

Set a 5-year plan to lead the UK to self-sustainability, less reliance on others, Create new targets to be achieved over a 5 year span of time, to lead the UK to increase its self suitability, and rely less on imports from other nations. In terms of agriculture, energy, medicines etc.
Also work to increase the science and engineering sectors of this nation., Brexit has lead us to see that without a deal we will struggle, with increasing prices, and so by increasing our own suitability, we would be able to tackle many issues. By promoting our science and engineering sectors we could become far more sustainable as well as increase our own exports to back up the economy.

Keep all indoor fitness facilities open in all tiers, including tier 4, To allow indoor fitness facilities and gyms to remain open in all tiers, including tier 4. Monitor facility capacity and ensure covid safety measures are in place., Figures suggest very low infection rates for covid within fitness facilities due to the constant cleaning of equipment after each user. Equipment is socially distant and majority of individuals train alone and stick to government guidelines. Fitness is extremely beneficial for those suffering with mental health issues, many relying on fitness facilities to keep themselves mentally stable. Closing indoor gyms once again will have a substantial negative effect on mental health sufferers.

Fund reduced peak rail fares, Currently many people cannot afford prices for trains, when they most need it, eg: commuting. Funding lower peak fares could help many more people get to work when then they need to, without facing disproportionate costs.,

Close all secondary schools due the risk of catching COVID-19, I feel as if the Government are not as they continuously keep stating "Following the science", due to the ongoing failure to close secondary schools, despite the high rates of Covid-19 at many schools, and the emergence of the new strain., Closing secondary schools until the R rate is brought down should help reduce transmission both between students and also teachers and contacts of both. I feel as if the government do not care about the health of students and are more focused on the economy. I politely ask that for them to place student’s health and safety as the priority in this situation. Social gatherings have been banned but at school social distancing is rarely followed and masks are rarely worn. This is not consistent.

Close all Click and Collect non-essential retail stores in Tier 4 areas, Click and Collect Non-Essential stores in Tier 4 areas should be required to close. Many do not provide correct PPE, and staff are required to go to work with colleagues, but are not able to see their family. Profits should not come before the health and wellbeing of staff.,

Keep gyms open, to reduce the impact of Depression,Diabetes and Obesity., Review and change the rules so that gyms and exercise facilities can remain open to serve the public in their physical and mental wellbeing journey.  Those who are dedicated to keeping themselves and their families healthy should not be punished., Anxiety and Depression are the  number 1 mental health problems in the UK and what's more worrying is symptoms and signs are not tangible.  According to the NHS, exercise is a "magic pill" against these conditions and gyms need to stay open even in the toughest lockdown conditions. All members we surveyed cited mental health benefits of training during lockdown. In addition it will help save jobs in a £5bn industry that could suffer it's worse decline in history if closures keep happening.

Ban plastic tag fasteners from clothing & gifts., Total ban on the plastic fasteners used to attach gift tags to clothing/products. This is something I have noticed after receiving gifts over Christmas, all of my gifts used the unrecyclable plastic fasteners., In the UK we generate 5 million tonnes of plastic each year. Banning this single use plastic would help to reduce that figure. There are alternative tagging materials that retailers can use e.g. string & safety pins, which I have seen some retailers use.
